Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.{u', u_2, u_4} {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M]
  [Module R M] {v : ι → M} [Fintype ι] : LinearIndependent R v ↔ ∀ (g : ι → R), ∑ i, g i • v i = 0 → ∀ (i : ι), g i = 0
linearIndependent_iff.{u', u_2, u_4} {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  {v : ι → M} : LinearIndependent R v ↔ ∀ (l : ι →₀ R), (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) l = 0 → l = 0
linearIndependent_iff'.{u', u_2, u_4} {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  {v : ι → M} : LinearIndependent R v ↔ ∀ (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → R), ∑ i ∈ s, g i • v i = 0 → ∀ i ∈ s, g i = 0
Module.Basis.linearIndependent.{u_1, u_2, u_4} {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [Semiring R]
  [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) : LinearIndependent R ⇑b
protected theorem Module.Basis.linearIndependent.{u_1, u_2, u_4} : ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4}
  [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (b : Module.Basis ι R M),
  LinearIndependent R ⇑b :=
fun {ι} {R} {M} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] b x y hxy =>
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = y) (Eq.symm (Module.Basis.repr_linearCombination b x))))
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => b.repr _a = y) hxy))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = y) (Module.Basis.repr_linearCombination b y))) (Eq.refl y)))
